outcome_classes.meaning: Required evidence gates pass, claim requirements are satisfied, provenance is inspectable, freshness is proven when relevant, and no hard-stop label is present.
Visible source context is present but does not verify the claim or canonical financial truth.
Context exists but is snippet-only, context-only, duplicated, stale, low-specificity, or otherwise insufficient for action.
Required query, response, timestamp, extracted metric, market-data, source, payload, route, or validation evidence is absent.
A claim family is detected and required evidence is not satisfied.
Runtime, provider, or search failure prevents complete assessment.
Audit/report-local row only; not a product remediation claim.

gates.pass_condition: Every row names real_signal_readiness_v1 or another explicit profile.
Detected claim families have required visible evidence categories.
Source coverage is claim_verified only when deterministic metadata says so and no hard-stop label is present.
Financial metric claims have canonical extracted metric or financial statement evidence.
Market price or technical trend claims have market data, price series, or technical indicator evidence.
Recent-news claims have claim-verified event/news evidence with inspectable source and published_at when freshness is required.
No degraded runtime/provider/search failure label is present.
Memory context can inform review but cannot satisfy financial truth or claim verification.

hard_stops: Do not derive claim_verified from model confidence, retrieval score, memory signal confidence, source-ready news, snippet-only context, or unknown_unclassified labels.
Do not collapse inventory, source openability, route health, model confidence, and current extracted-payload accuracy into one pass rate.
Do not mutate DB, Qdrant, news, memory, parser routing, extraction prompts, gold labels, runtime, model, or service config while computing the report-local scorecard.
If canonical financial rows or generated extracted payload artifacts are missing, emit DATA_MISSING.

recommended_child_task.summary: Create a report-local normalizer that emits real_signal_readiness_v1 rows from existing metadata only.
